lines.en: Creeping closer
Tentacles sway
Eyes on you
Gulp you down

lines.zh: 我从石柱里抬眼，看见了你。
lines.en: I lift my gaze from the pillar and see you.

lines.zh: 立在独石上，我一动不动。
lines.en: Standing on the monolith, I do not move.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞壁一寸寸挪动。
lines.en: I inch along the cave wall.
Silent approach
Drift slowly
The pillar grinds across the bone waste.
Monolith feet drag it slowly forward.
A two-block pillar bears down on you.

lines.zh: 两根柱子叠起来，我就是了。
lines.en: Two blocks stacked, and I am made.
Eye the void
Silent stillness
Watchful gaze

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等洞里安静。
lines.en: I hold still until the cave goes quiet.
Guardian's calm

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一截石柱。
lines.en: I stand motionless as a stone pillar.
Deep eyes

lines.zh: 石块相互摩擦，说个不停。
lines.en: The stones grind together, talking without end.
Monolith glow, standing still.
Prophet ash circles the pillar.
The void eye opens and closes slowly.
From the top it stares; the waste is silent.
Unworshipped, it keeps its watch.

lines.zh: 两格高的柱子，眼一直睁着。
lines.en: A two-block pillar, and my eye never shuts.
The two-block pillar stands square to you.

lines.zh: 你回头时，柱子已经换了位置。
lines.en: When you look back, the pillar has moved.

lines.zh: 你挪一步，我的裂缝就转一次。
lines.en: Each step you take turns my crack once.
Player found
Focusing on you

lines.zh: 我的目光钉在你的后颈。
lines.en: My gaze pins the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 我石缝里的眼睛都朝下。
lines.en: The eyes in my stone seams all look down.
The crack in my pillar turns toward you.
You're in frame
The void eye turns to you.
Across the bone waste, its gaze pins you.

lines.zh: 独石一亮，锁住你的身影
lines.en: The monolith brightens and locks onto you.
It remembers your footsteps.
The prophet whispers: he is here.
Deep in its pupil, your face appears.
You walk into its field of view.
The pillar tilts slightly, eyes following you.
It counts your heartbeats.
A two-block shadow falls over you.
Body distorting...
Cobblestone cracking...
Void Eyes glowing...
Prophet's warning fails...
Cannot endure loneliness...
Fractured will...
Decaying flesh...
Void consumes me...
Cobblestone armor shatters...
In despair...

lines.zh: 你会被它的光芒迷惑吗？
lines.en: Will you be lured by its glow?
Do you feel its gaze?

lines.zh: 它的光芒如此诱人，你能否抵挡？
lines.en: Its light is so alluring, can you resist?

lines.zh: 它的存在就是一种诱惑。
lines.en: Its presence is a temptation.

lines.zh: 它的光芒吸引着你靠近。
lines.en: Its light draws you near.

lines.zh: 它那空洞的眼神让你不安。
lines.en: Its hollow eyes unsettle you.
Can you resist its call?

lines.zh: 它的光芒让你无法移开视线。
lines.en: Its light holds your gaze.

lines.zh: 它的注视让你无法平静。
lines.en: Its gaze unsettles you.

lines.zh: 你被它的光芒深深吸引。
lines.en: You are drawn to its light.
You hit the pillar and your shoulder goes numb.
You accidentally bumped into it.

lines.zh: 你试图靠近却碰到了它。
lines.en: You tried to get closer but bumped into it.

lines.zh: 它的身形挡住了你的去路。
lines.en: Its form blocked your path.

lines.zh: 我只两格高，也拦得住你。
lines.en: Two blocks tall, and I still block you.

lines.zh: 你试图绕过它，却撞上了。
lines.en: You tried to go around it but bumped into it.

lines.zh: 它的存在让你不得不改变路线。
lines.en: Its presence forced you to change your route.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的身体，被吓了一跳。
lines.en: You bumped into its body, startling you.
You bumped into its column.

lines.zh: 你试图避开它却撞上了。
lines.en: You tried to avoid it but bumped into it.
It searches for its mate.
Where is its partner?

lines.zh: 它的存在是为了找到伴侣。
lines.en: Its existence is to find a mate.
It searches around.

lines.zh: 它在寻找与它类似的生物。
lines.en: It searches for similar beings.
Its gaze searches for its kind.
It yearns to find its mate.

lines.zh: 它的存在就是为了遇见另一只。
lines.en: Its existence is to meet another.
It searches in the darkness for a mate.
Where is its companion?

lines.zh: 独石在我脚下闪耀，虚空之息随之而来。
lines.en: Quartz shines beneath me, bringing whispers of void.
I smell the presence of the Seer.

lines.zh: 虚空之眼注视着我，我感受到它的力量。
lines.en: Void Eyes watch over me, feeling their power.

lines.zh: 这根柱子是我不死的象征。
lines.en: This column is a symbol of my immortality.

lines.zh: 孤独的旅者，我将你纳入视野。
lines.en: Traveler, I see you.

lines.zh: 我的触手感受到你的气息。
lines.en: My tentacles feel your presence.

lines.zh: 你藏不住，我已锁定目标。
lines.en: You cannot hide, I have locked onto you.
You will only be food.
My power comes from quartz.
Void Eyes, observe all.
You're the one who raised the monolith.

lines.zh: 石柱上的眼睛都睁开了。
lines.en: Every eye on the stone pillar opens.
You are now in my memory.
My shadow will cover you.

lines.zh: 你将成为我食粮的一部分。
lines.en: You will be part of my food.
My tentacles will envelop you.
You cannot escape my sight.
My power will consume you.

lines.zh: 你的心跳传到了石头上。
lines.en: Your heartbeat travels into the stone.
You will nourish me.
Entered in the ledger, never erased.
Your name is cut into the monolith.
The waste has one more quarry.
The void eye has marked you.
You are recorded in the lost civilization.
It takes you for an offering.

lines.zh: 我的视线压得你迈不开腿。
lines.en: My stare weighs your legs down.

lines.zh: 你即将感受到我的怒火。
lines.en: You will feel my rage.
My tentacles will tear you.
You will be devoured by me.
You will become void.
My strength will crush you.

lines.zh: 你盖的柱子，现在困住你。
lines.en: The pillar you built now traps you.
You will never be free.

lines.zh: 两格高的我，也一样看得清。
lines.en: Two blocks tall, and I still see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你将被我吞噬，化为虚无。
lines.en: You will be devoured, becoming void.
The pillar's shadow presses in; nowhere to retreat.
The void splits open beneath your feet.
It reaches out, and the void tightens.
The monolith shakes, ready to harvest.
The waste swallows your way back.
Its two-block frame closes in one step.
The void eye widens and widens.
It fences you onto the altar.
One last glance, saved for you.
The lost civilization needs an offering.

lines.zh: 石臂砸下来，土都跳起来。
lines.en: My stone arm slams down, and the dirt leaps.
Swings its claws at you!
Its eyes glow green!
Trying to devour your soul!
You feel its rage!
It wraps you with its tentacles!

lines.zh: 你被其恐怖的叫声吓住！
lines.en: Its terrifying scream petrifies you!
Built Overseer attacks with obsidian!
Its tentacles try to tear you apart!
Its void eyes stare at you!
The pillar slams down, bone chips fly.
Tendrils wrap around your ankle.
The void eye fires a cold beam.
The monolith's edge opens your flesh.
Its pickaxe scar still fresh, it rages.
The waste shakes as the blow lands.

lines.zh: 独石亮起，我从地里长出来。
lines.en: The monolith glows, and I grow out of the ground.
Hatches from a pillar!

lines.zh: 两格高的柱，从地面立起。
lines.en: A two-block pillar rises from the floor.
Born near lava!
Appears from a void eye!
Awakens in a cave!
It appears in your territory!
Rises from a pile of obsidian!
Steps out of the void!

lines.zh: 地面震动，石柱立起来了。
lines.en: The ground shakes, and the pillar rises.

lines.zh: 独石、先知、虚空之眼合柱
lines.en: Monolith, prophet and void eye join into a pillar.
Right-click the monolith and I rise.

lines.zh: 玩家亲手立起这根柱子
lines.en: A player raised this pillar by hand.
A two-block pillar opens its single eye.
On the bone waste, the pillar takes shape.
The void eye settles, and I wake.

lines.zh: 独石叠起，我自其中现形
lines.en: Monoliths stacked, I take form within.
The lost civilization gains another pillar.
Above the flesh plains, I stand up.

lines.zh: 玩家造了我，也唤醒了我
lines.en: A player made me, and woke me.
Fire burns...

lines.zh: 石屑从我身上掉了一路。
lines.en: Stone chips trail off me as I fall.
Void water suffocates...
Torn apart by explosion...
The arrowhead lodges in my stone seam.
Magic corrodes...
Starvation weakens...

lines.zh: 雷打在石柱上，我的眼睛亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck the pillar; my eye flashed.
Void devours...
